Class Card

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.model.entities.card.Card
Direct Known Subclasses:
Building, Character, Event
public abstract class Card extends Object
Abstract base class for all cards in the game.

A card carries a set of instant effects applied when the card is drawn or a phase trigger fires, and optionally a set of interactive effects that generate pending Action instances to be resolved by the owner. Each card belongs to an age (1–3), has a type, and is associated with a trigger that gates when its instant effects may fire.

Concrete subclasses cover three categories: characters (Builder, Crafter, Gatherer, Hunter, Painter, Shaman), events (Feast, Hunt, Ritual, StonePainting), and buildings (Building). Jackson uses the type property to deserialize the correct subclass.

The Visitor pattern is used for type-specific dispatch: each concrete subclass implements the accept overloads to call the matching visit method on the visitor.

    • canApply

      public boolean canApply(GamePhaseEnum trigger, GamePhaseEnum currPhase)
      Returns whether this effect may fire given the card's trigger phase and the current game phase. The default implementation requires an exact match between the two phases.
      Parameters:
      trigger - the phase associated with the card carrying this effect
      currPhase - the current game phase
      Returns:
      true if the effect may fire

    • execInstantEffect

      public void execInstantEffect(Player p, GamePhaseEnum currPhase)
      Applies all eligible instant effects of this card to the given player for the current game phase, removing one-time effects after they fire.

      An effect fires only if canApply(GamePhaseEnum, GamePhaseEnum) returns true for this card's trigger and the current phase.

      Parameters:
      p - the player to apply the effects to
      currPhase - the current game phase

    • execInteractiveEffect

      public List<Action> execInteractiveEffect(Player p)
      Applies the interactive effects of this card to the given player, returning any resulting pending actions.

      The default implementation returns an empty list; subclasses that carry interactive effects should override this method.

      Parameters:
      p - the player to apply the effects to
      Returns:
      list of pending actions generated; never null
